strings.name: Pan Zhanle
strings.summary: Pan Zhanle is a Chinese freestyle swimmer who won the men’s 100m freestyle at Paris 2024 in a long-course world record of 46.40. He also won men’s 4×100m medley relay gold with his teammates. His record includes individual and relay results at the Olympics, world championships, Asian Games and domestic meets.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Long-course 50m pools, short-course 25m pools, relay lead-offs and later legs are distinguished. Team results are not individual records; planned starts are not completed races.
strings.influence.rationale: Olympic champion and freestyle world-record setter, marking a major breakthrough for Asian sprint swimming.
strings.facts.f1.label: Paris Olympic medals
strings.facts.f1.value: Two golds and one silver in 2024: men’s 100m freestyle and men’s 4×100m medley golds, plus mixed 4×100m medley silver.
strings.facts.f2.label: Comparing times
strings.facts.f2.value: 46.40 is a 50m-pool individual world record; the Paris anchor’s 45.92 is a relay split, while the 2026 national-meet 46.20 was in a 25m pool.
strings.highlights.h1.title: A breakthrough in the 100m freestyle
strings.highlights.h1.text: In 2024 he set 46.80 on the Doha relay lead-off, then lowered the world record to 46.40 in the Paris individual final.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Relay teamwork
strings.highlights.h2.text: Won Paris men’s medley relay gold with Xu Jiayu, Qin Haiyang and Sun Jiajun in a team time of 3:27.46.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Named in Beijing short-course worlds plans
strings.timeline.t1.text: The Beijing News reports his inclusion in China’s team, citing organizers; the December 1–6 competition had not occurred at the cutoff.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Wins national short-course 100m
strings.timeline.t2.text: Swims 46.20 in the men’s 100m freestyle final in a 25m pool in Beijing; this is not directly comparable with the long-course record.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Retains Asian Games 100m title
strings.timeline.t3.text: Wins in 47.61 at Tokyo Aquatics Centre, the venue for this Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games final.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Misses Singapore worlds final
strings.timeline.t4.text: Swims 47.81 in the men’s 100m freestyle semifinals and does not advance; third in his semifinal is not an event bronze medal.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Paris men’s medley relay gold
strings.timeline.t5.text: China wins in 3:27.46 with Pan on the freestyle anchor leg; his 45.92 is a relay split.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Olympic 100m gold and world record
strings.timeline.t6.text: Wins the men’s 100m freestyle final in 46.40, improving his own long-course world record.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Doha lead-off world record
strings.timeline.t7.text: His 46.80 opening leg in the men’s 4×100m freestyle is recognized as a 100m world record; China also wins relay gold.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Hangzhou Asian Games 100m gold
strings.timeline.t8.text: Wins in 46.97; the postponed edition of the Games took place in 2023.
